title: 線上排序與學習閉環
Online ranking and the learning loop
caption: 圖 1 · 原創重畫與設計綜合，參考 Facebook 2014 online learning loop。深色框是請求／曝光邊界，綠色框是線上或發布元件；點擊和曝光在離線／近線路徑 join。只有實際呈現的曝光進入 CTR label 母體。線上特徵可由 batch 與 stream 更新，圖中省略各自儲存副本。

Figure 1 · Original redraw and design synthesis informed by Facebook's 2014 online learning loop. Dark boxes mark request/exposure boundaries; green boxes identify serving or release components. Clicks join impressions off the request path. CTR labels use actually rendered impressions. Batch and stream feature updates can coexist; separate storage replicas are omitted.

title: 標籤成熟與資料時間
Label maturity and data time
nodes: 範例觀測窗 W = 5 分鐘
Event time is inside the window
去重並依曝光 ID 歸因
同一筆曝光、同一份特徵
資料完整時才定案負例
版本化修正與訓練快照
caption: 圖 2 · 原創教學反例，所有時間為假設。10:08 才收到的點擊發生於 10:04，仍屬曝光後五分鐘內；不能把 arrival time 當 event time。watermark 是進度估計，不保證沒有更晚事件；定案後的窗內晚到事件需要明確修正或排除政策。10:06 才發生的點擊則不屬此五分鐘 target。

Figure 2 · Original teaching example with hypothetical times. A click arriving at 10:08 occurred at 10:04 and belongs to the five-minute target. Arrival time is not event time. A watermark estimates progress, not the impossibility of late arrivals; in-window events arriving after finalization need an explicit correction or exclusion policy. A click occurring at 10:06 is outside this target.

title: 共用使用者計算與候選條件化
Shared user computation and candidate conditioning
nodes: 對候選條件化的歷史讀取
caption: 圖 3 · 原創重畫，受 Meta 2026 非同步 user model／online ranker 分工啟發。加入版本與資料年齡、近期事件支路及 candidate-conditioned 讀取，屬教學設計。只有 candidate-independent 的計算可跨廣告共用；不能把依賴當前廣告的 attention 結果當作通用 user embedding 快取。

Figure 3 · Original redraw inspired by Meta's 2026 asynchronous-user/online-ranker split. Version/age tracking, a recent-event branch, and candidate-conditioned reading are teaching design choices. Only candidate-independent computation can be shared across ads; an attention result conditioned on one ad is not a universal cached user embedding.
